_comment: 🧩️ The plugin host owns its replay and mounted-relay lifecycle semantics. AJV independently validates the neutral trace schema, while Rust and TypeScript execute the committed traces through separate state-machine implementations.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: Replay-seed and mounted-relay retirement are repository-owned authority semantics with no external implementation that can adjudicate them. Confidence comes from schema-valid committed traces, bounded accounting and no-spin properties, and independently written Rust production-machine and TypeScript state-machine executions.
